# Bars

*Describes silverpoint 0.7.0.*

8 charts. Shared props, the data shapes and the recommender are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md).

**Contents:** [BulletChart](#bulletchart) · [PyramidChart](#pyramidchart) · [BarChart](#barchart) · [StackedBarChart](#stackedbarchart) · [ComposedChart](#composedchart) · [WaterfallChart](#waterfallchart) · [FunnelChart](#funnelchart) · [CandlestickChart](#candlestickchart)

## BulletChart

`bullet-chart` · One bar per target, with a marker at the target. Values in 0-100.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `BulletChart` | `SpBulletChart` | `sp-bullet-chart` | `bullet_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/bullet-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/bullet-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/bullet-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `categories`; intents `progress`, `kpi`, `compare`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| title | `titleKey` | string | yes |
| actual | `actualKey` | number | yes |
| target | `targetKey` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows, drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "title": "Revenue", "actual": 72, "target": 80 }, { "title": "Profit", "actual": 58, "target": 65 }, { "title": "New users", "actual": 86, "target": 75 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `titleKey` | `Accessor<string>` | `'title'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `actualKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'actual'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `targetKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'target'` | Ignored without `data`. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { BulletChart } from '@silverpoint/react/bullet-chart';

export function BulletChartView({ rows }: { rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }) {
  return (
    <BulletChart
      data={rows}
      titleKey="title"
      actualKey="actual"
      targetKey="target"
      title="Bullet chart"
    />
  );
}
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { SpBulletChart } from '@silverpoint/vue/bullet-chart';

defineProps<{ rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <SpBulletChart
    :data="rows"
    titleKey="title"
    actualKey="actual"
    targetKey="target"
    title="Bullet chart"
  />
</template>
```

```ts angular
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, input } from '@angular/core';
import { SpBulletChart } from '@silverpoint/angular/bullet-chart';

/** Add '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css', '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css' to the `styles` of angular.json. */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-bullet-chart-view',
  imports: [SpBulletChart],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <sp-bullet-chart
      [data]="rows()"
      [titleKey]="'title'"
      [actualKey]="'actual'"
      [targetKey]="'target'"
      [title]="'Bullet chart'"
    />
  `,
})
export class BulletChartView {
  readonly rows = input.required<readonly Record<string, unknown>[]>();
}
```

## PyramidChart

`pyramid-chart` · Stacked tiers whose width encodes the value (0-100).

| Name | `PyramidChart` | `SpPyramidChart` | `sp-pyramid-chart` | `pyramid_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/pyramid-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/pyramid-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/pyramid-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `categories`; intents `rank`, `compare`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| label | `labelKey` | string | yes |
| width | `widthKey` | number | yes |

## BarChart

`bar-chart` · Pill bars, as columns or rows, with an optional second series.

| Import | `@silverpoint/react/bar-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/bar-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/bar-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `categories`; intents `compare`, `rank`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| x | `xKey` | string | yes |
| value | `valueKey` | number | yes |
| secondary | `secondaryKey` | number | no |

## StackedBarChart

`stacked-bar-chart` · One stacked segment per key.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `StackedBarChart` | `SpStackedBarChart` | `sp-stacked-bar-chart` | `stacked_bar_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/stacked-bar-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/stacked-bar-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/stacked-bar-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `categories`; intents `compare`, `part-to-whole`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| x | `xKey` | string | yes |
| values | `keys` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows (read through 0="free", 1="pro", 2="team"), drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "x": "Jan", "free": 40, "pro": 18, "team": 6 }, { "x": "Feb", "free": 46, "pro": 21, "team": 9 }, { "x": "Mar", "free": 38, "pro": 26, "team": 11 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xKey` | `Accessor<string \| number>` | `'x'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `keys` | `readonly string[]` |  | Ignored without `data`. |
| `names` | `readonly string[]` |  | Display names of the keys, in order; the keys themselves by default. Ignored without `data`. |

## WaterfallChart

`waterfall-chart` · Totals from zero and floating deltas from the running total.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `WaterfallChart` | `SpWaterfallChart` | `sp-waterfall-chart` | `waterfall_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/waterfall-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/waterfall-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/waterfall-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `categories`; intents `change`, `part-to-whole`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| step | `stepKey` | string | yes |
| base | `baseKey` | number | no |
| delta | `deltaKey` | number | no |

The demo's first rows, drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "step": "Opening", "base": 120 }, { "step": "Sales", "delta": 64 }, { "step": "Services", "delta": 22 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stepKey` | `Accessor<string>` | `'step'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `baseKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'base'` | An absolute total: the bar starts at zero and resets the running total. Ignored without `data`. |
| `deltaKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'delta'` | A change from the running total. Ignored without `data`. |

### Example
